item.title: Aristotle Couldn't Figure Out Eels. Neither Can We.
item.description: There is a category of scientific question whose persistence is not a function of effort but of empirical access. The eel is the cleanest case — twenty-three centuries deep, on supermarket shelves, and we still cannot fully explain how it reproduces.

item.title: The Grip That Never Was
item.description: Why your fingerprints actually make you worse at gripping things — and what they're really for.

item.title: The Blind Fish That Didn't Rewire Its Brain
item.description: An essay exploring how blind cavefish repurpose visual neural tissue — and what it means for how we think about losing capabilities.
